purpose: Prepare, invoke, validate, and optionally materialize a bounded UTF-8 software-project proposal or execute one prepared stepwise perspective checkpoint through an explicitly selected OpenAI-compatible loopback provider such as AXM Local Workshop/WALDO, while keeping provider cognition, host authority, deterministic validation, runtime evidence, and machine evolution separate.

properties.operation: inspect, prepare, invoke, create, or analyze-checkpoint
properties.path: create only; caller-selected destination project path
properties.context: optional inspectable structural context; never hidden authority
properties.provider: loopback OpenAI-compatible provider configuration; allow_call=true is required before network invocation
properties.checks: optional deterministic project checks selected by the caller
properties.publish_mode: validated by default; grounded-draft remains explicit
properties.workflow: analyze-checkpoint only; exact digest-bound stepwise workflow awaiting analysis
properties.checkpoint: analyze-checkpoint only; exact digest-bound prepared perspective checkpoint

contains: validated provider-supplied perspective analyses and updated workflow when operation=analyze-checkpoint

anatomy_refs.basis: The live boundary adapts one explicit loopback OpenAI-compatible provider request and response into a strict AXM project-proposal contract without granting the provider destination, installation, adoption, or machine-body authority.
Validated provider files enter the existing transactional project builder rather than a second publication implementation.
Materialized provider proposals receive the existing independent structural and digest verification report.

relationships: connects to AXM Local Workshop native WALDO bridge at the same OpenAI-compatible shape used by other local models
fills a missing files input only when the caller explicitly supplies a provider with allow_call=true
keeps semantic proposal generation outside the deterministic core while keeping validation and authority inside
leaves runtime, browser, visual, gameplay, and semantic claims for separately bound host evidence
can execute prepared perspective method overlays through one explicitly selected local cognition provider without pretending they are separate identities or independent evidence sources
limitations: v0.2 accepts UTF-8 text project files only
the provider endpoint must be explicit loopback HTTP; no cloud control plane is accepted
provider output is not semantic, runtime, browser, visual, gameplay, or root-fit proof
the capability does not install organs, adopt candidates, mutate CANON, grant permissions, or rewrite the machine body
model output may vary even when the request packet is identical; both request and response digests remain visible
one provider executing several specialist profiles is one cognition applying several methods, not several independent specialist identities

truth.basis: Provider identity, loopback endpoint, request contract, raw-response digest, normalized proposal or perspective analyses, structural verification, and unproven evidence classes remain explicit.

agency.basis: The caller selects the provider, model, destination, goal, constraints, checks, publication mode, replacement choice, and explicitly enables each local call.

continuity.basis: Provider files enter the existing transactional project body and do not alter Universal Creation or the Local Workshop architecture.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: A provider proposal is schema-bounded and independently structurally verified before publication; unsupported paths, file types, endpoints, and claims stop visibly.
